label: comparator record
definition: A record of an external database admitted to the register as a line of a snapshot of that dataset; never a project of the partnership.
scope_note: A comparator record is a line; it is not a separate kind of reference.

label: crosswalk
definition: A reviewed, dated mapping from one publisher's own vocabulary onto a shared axis or the purpose list; the only place a shared status is asserted.

label: external identifier
definition: A code another register uses for one of the ledger's identities or lines, typed by scheme, such as a World Bank P-number or an IATI activity identifier.

label: agreement
definition: Funder-side money: a party commits an amount under an instrument to a counterparty, with states of the document that embodies it and flows on it.

label: asset
definition: A physical thing at a site, such as a plant, a unit, a transmission line or a mini-grid, with capacity, technology, location and operator.

label: country
definition: A partnership country as the subject of a macro-fiscal observation, identified by its ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.

label: document
definition: A logical publication with a title, a document type, a canonical URL and one or more publishers; an edition is a document related to its predecessor.

label: line
definition: One publisher's dated assertion at one locator in one snapshot: the first-class unit of the ledger, from which every identity is minted.

label: observation
definition: One dated statement about one subject, cited to exactly one line, with a measure, a value in the publisher's unit and one or more timings.

label: party
definition: A named organisation in a role, such as funder, channel, promoter or operator.

label: perimeter
definition: A coverage definition the ledger counts against, such as a pledge envelope, a portfolio or a plan list at a cutoff, with membership as justified relations.

label: project
definition: An undertaking with a scope, an owner and a duration that creates or changes assets or delivers something non-physical, minted only by a reviewed match across lines.

label: publisher
definition: The body that publishes a document and answers for what it states, such as a partnership secretariat, a ministry or a development bank.

label: retrieval
definition: One attempt to fetch one document at one time, with its date, outcome and, when bytes came back, the snapshot they form.

label: snapshot
definition: Exact bytes under a SHA-256 fingerprint, with their storage path; the ledger cites a snapshot, never a URL, so that what was read can be re-read.

label: timing
definition: One date role of an observation, with its date, precision and bounds, so that a value is stored once however many dates it carries.

label: about
definition: An observation is about one typed subject.

label: cites
definition: A line refers to another document or line, or an observation cites the one line it was read from.

label: component of
definition: A project is contained in another project; containment is acyclic.

label: concerns
definition: A project concerns an asset, or a condition binds a party; zero or more per subject.

label: edition of
definition: A document succeeds a previous edition of the same publication.

label: finances
definition: An agreement finances a project; many-to-many, and the hierarchy never splits money.

label: groups
definition: A heading line groups the lines under it in the same document, including a method note that governs them.

label: in snapshot
definition: A line stands in a snapshot at a locator and ordinal.

label: member of
definition: A line or an identity is a dated, justified member of a perimeter; a line may be a member before any identity is minted.

label: part of
definition: An asset is a unit within another asset, such as a unit within a plant.

label: party in
definition: A party holds a role in an agreement, one row per role, so a party may fund one agreement and channel another.

label: published by
definition: A document is published by a publisher, with an optional role such as author, co-signatory or host.

label: refers to
definition: The dated, reviewed match that minted or attached an identity to a line; it never deletes the line.

label: retrieval of
definition: A retrieval is one fetch attempt of a document.

label: role in
definition: A party holds a mandate outside any agreement, such as lead agency or guarantor, on a project, asset, perimeter, document or line.

label: same as
definition: A justified claim that two rows of the same kind are one thing, such as one publication under two URLs or one item printed in two places; it does not choose a route.

label: timed
definition: An observation has one timing row per date role; the amount lives once on the observation.

label: tranche of
definition: An agreement is a tranche of another agreement, with at most one active parent.

label: translation of
definition: A document is the same publication in another language; lines are extracted from one and cross-referenced, never doubled.

label: yields
definition: A successful retrieval returned the bytes of a snapshot; a failed retrieval yields nothing.

label: announced
definition: The asset has been announced, with no permit sought.

label: cancelled
definition: The asset will not be built.

label: construction
definition: The asset is under construction.

label: mothballed
definition: The asset is out of operation but kept for possible restart.

label: operating
definition: The asset is in operation.

label: permitted
definition: The asset has its permits and has not started construction.

label: pre-permit
definition: The asset is being developed and permits are being sought.

label: retired
definition: The asset has been permanently shut down.

label: retirement agreed
definition: Early retirement of the asset has been agreed by the parties that decide it.

label: retirement proposed
definition: Early retirement of the asset has been proposed but not agreed.

label: shelved
definition: Work on the asset has stopped without cancellation.

label: bilateral funder
definition: A bilateral development agency or bank.

label: ipg
definition: The International Partners Group or one of its members acting as such.

label: jetp secretariat
definition: The secretariat of a Just Energy Transition Partnership.

label: multilateral funder
definition: A multilateral development bank or fund.

label: national government
definition: A ministry, agency or other body of a partner government.

label: operator
definition: A utility or other operator of energy assets.

label: private finance
definition: A private financial institution or alliance.

label: secondary source
definition: A publisher reporting on others, such as the press or a research body.

label: asset state
definition: The state of an asset in its lifecycle, from announcement to retirement.

label: delivery
definition: Whether the activity an agreement funds is in the pipeline, under way, closing, closed, cancelled or suspended.

label: money
definition: The state of an agreement as a document: announced to signed, cancelled or withdrawn.

label: project stage
definition: The stage of a project, from identification to decommissioning.

label: gross
definition: A money value before any repayment, reflow or netting.

label: net
definition: A money value after repayments or reflows are deducted.

label: unknown
definition: A money value whose basis no line states.

label: Indonesia
definition: Indonesia, a partnership country.

label: Senegal
definition: Senegal, a partnership country.

label: Viet Nam
definition: Viet Nam, a partnership country.

label: South Africa
definition: South Africa, a partnership country.

label: international
definition: A publisher or document not tied to one partnership country.

label: day
definition: The date is known to the day.
notes: Values proposed with ticket 0880 from the precisions of event-timing.csv (day, year, unknown), with month and quarter for quarterly and monthly reports.

label: month
definition: The date is known to the month.
notes: Values proposed with ticket 0880 from the precisions of event-timing.csv (day, year, unknown), with month and quarter for quarterly and monthly reports.

label: quarter
definition: The date is known to the quarter.
notes: Values proposed with ticket 0880 from the precisions of event-timing.csv (day, year, unknown), with month and quarter for quarterly and monthly reports.

label: unknown
definition: The precision of the date is not known.
notes: Values proposed with ticket 0880 from the precisions of event-timing.csv (day, year, unknown), with month and quarter for quarterly and monthly reports.

label: year
definition: The date is known to the year.
notes: Values proposed with ticket 0880 from the precisions of event-timing.csv (day, year, unknown), with month and quarter for quarterly and monthly reports.

label: approval
definition: The date a decision-maker approved the subject.

label: event
definition: The date a thing happened, such as a signature or a point flow.

label: period end
definition: The last day of the interval a flow covers.

label: period start
definition: The first day of the interval a flow covers.

label: planned
definition: A date the publisher plans for the subject, not yet reached.

label: register date
definition: The date a register states for its row.

label: report date
definition: The date a report was published or signed.

label: reporting cutoff
definition: The date up to which a report states its figures.

label: target
definition: The date by which a target is to be reached.

label: accepted
definition: The row is in force when no row supersedes it.

label: candidate
definition: The row is pending review and not in force.

label: rejected
definition: A terminal rejected row revokes whatever its chain previously accepted.

label: flow coverage
definition: An adjudication of which period or perimeter a flow covers.

label: identity
definition: An adjudication that rows are, or are not, one identity.

label: occurrence membership
definition: An adjudication that a flow or state belongs to one occurrence.

label: perimeter compatibility
definition: An adjudication that two perimeters can or cannot be compared.

label: cancelled
definition: The activity was cancelled.

label: closed
definition: The activity is closed.

label: finalisation
definition: Physical activity is complete or the final disbursement has been made, with the activity still open.

label: implementation
definition: The activity is under way.

label: pipeline
definition: The activity is being scoped or planned.

label: suspended
definition: The activity is temporarily suspended.

label: annual report
definition: A yearly report of a publisher.

label: approval document
definition: A funder's document approving an operation.

label: data portal
definition: A database or portal published by a register.

label: financing agreement
definition: The signed text of a financing agreement.

label: implementation plan
definition: A plan that states how the investments are to be carried out.

label: investment plan
definition: A plan that states the investments a partnership needs.

label: official news
definition: A news release of an official body.

label: operator report
definition: A report of a utility or operator.

label: political declaration
definition: A declaration by which partners set up or restate a partnership.

label: progress update
definition: A report of progress between annual reports.

label: project list
definition: A list or register of projects, grants or positions.

label: project page
definition: A web page about one project.

label: secondary news
definition: A press article or other secondary report.

label: commitment
definition: A firm written obligation to provide funds.

label: disbursement
definition: Funds paid out to a recipient.

label: expenditure
definition: Funds spent directly on goods and services.

label: pledge
definition: A promise of funds that is not yet a binding commitment.

label: absence
definition: A line where the publisher states that something is not there, such as an empty list or a withheld item.

label: count
definition: A count the publisher gives without naming what is counted.

label: envelope
definition: A total the publisher states for a partnership, portfolio or programme.

label: evaluation
definition: A line that records the publisher's assessment of a submission or item.

label: heading
definition: A line that groups other lines under a governance or budget envelope, or states a method note that governs them.

label: named item
definition: A line that names the one item it states, such as a project, a plant or a grant.

label: quota
definition: A line that states a quantity to be procured or allocated rather than an item, such as 250 MW of capacity.

label: register allocation
definition: A row of a funder register that allocates an amount from a funder to a use.

label: submission
definition: A line whose publisher puts something forward for a decision not yet taken, such as a promoter's submission.

label: unnamed item
definition: A line that states an item without naming it, such as an unresolved position in a plan annex.

label: broadMatch
definition: The external concept is broader than the term.

label: closeMatch
definition: The external concept is close enough to use in most contexts.

label: exactMatch
definition: The external concept can be used in place of the term.

label: local
definition: The ledger defines the word itself; no external concept is claimed.

label: narrowMatch
definition: The external concept is narrower than the term.

label: relatedMatch
definition: The external concept is related to the term, without either containing the other.

label: adaptation
definition: The Rio marker for climate change adaptation.

label: biodiversity
definition: The Rio marker for biological diversity.

label: desertification
definition: The Rio marker for combating desertification.

label: gender
definition: The OECD DAC policy marker for gender equality, a non-Rio marker.

label: mitigation
definition: The Rio marker for climate change mitigation.

label: not targeted
definition: The activity was screened and does not target the objective.

label: significant
definition: The objective is significant: important but not the main reason for the activity.

label: principal
definition: The objective is principal: the main reason for the activity.

label: not screened
definition: The marker field is blank; this is not a score of 0.

label: absence
definition: A statement that something is not there, counted as zero only when the publisher says so.

label: amount
definition: The amount of money at a state of an agreement, with the publisher's own status word.

label: capacity
definition: The capacity of an asset, with its unit.

label: condition
definition: A condition of an agreement as printed, whose concerns relation names the party it binds.

label: count
definition: A count, with the publisher's unit named: rows, locomotives, officials trained, households.

label: envelope
definition: A total for a partnership or a portfolio.

label: estimate
definition: A cost estimate on a plan line, with no funder.

label: flow
definition: A money movement on an agreement, typed by flow_type and timed by an event or a period.

label: grace years
definition: The grace period of a loan in years.

label: grant element
definition: The grant element of a loan, as a share of its face value.

label: indicator
definition: A macro-fiscal value of a country or a party, with the publisher's indicator code.

label: interest rate
definition: The interest rate of a loan, as a publisher reports it at a date.

label: length
definition: The length of a linear asset, such as a transmission line, with its unit.

label: marker
definition: The donor's policy-marker score of an activity at a reporting year: 0, 1 or 2, or not_screened.

label: maturity years
definition: The maturity of a loan in years.

label: state
definition: A state of a subject on one of the shared status axes.

label: target
definition: A physical or social objective with a target timing, such as a renewable share by 2030.

label: General budget support
definition: Money paid to a recipient government's budget for its own use.

label: Sector budget support
definition: Money paid to a recipient government's budget for one sector.

label: Core support to NGOs and other private bodies
definition: Money paid to the general budget of a non-governmental or private body.

label: Core contributions to multilateral institutions
definition: Money paid to the general budget of a multilateral institution.

label: Contributions to specific-purpose programmes and funds
definition: Money paid to a programme or fund with a set purpose, managed by an implementing partner.

label: Basket funds or pooled funding
definition: Money paid into a fund pooled by several donors.

label: Project-type interventions
definition: Money for a project with its own inputs, activities and outputs.

label: Donor country personnel
definition: Experts from the donor country paid by the donor.

label: Other technical assistance
definition: Technical assistance other than donor country personnel.

label: Scholarships and training in the donor country
definition: Grants for students and trainees studying in the donor country.

label: Debt relief
definition: Forgiveness, rescheduling or other relief of a recipient's debt.

label: unknown
definition: No line states the type of aid of the agreement.

label: announced
definition: The agreement has been announced publicly.

label: approved
definition: The funder's board or authority has approved the agreement.

label: cancelled
definition: The agreement was cancelled after announcement, approval or signature.

label: MoU
definition: A memorandum of understanding records the agreement, without a binding commitment.

label: signed
definition: The agreement has been signed by the parties.

label: withdrawn
definition: A party withdrew from the agreement.

label: component
definition: A part of a larger project, related to it by component_of.

label: programme
definition: An undertaking that groups other projects under one governance or budget envelope.

label: project
definition: A single undertaking with its own scope, owner and duration.

label: cancelled
definition: The project was cancelled before completion.

label: completion
definition: The project is being completed and handed over.

label: decommissioned
definition: The project has been decommissioned.

label: decommissioning
definition: The project is being decommissioned.

label: identification
definition: The project is being identified and scoped.

label: implementation
definition: The project is being built or delivered.

label: maintenance
definition: The project is complete and being operated and maintained.

label: preparation
definition: The project is being designed, appraised and prepared for funding and procurement.

label: blocked
definition: The server refused the retrieval.

label: collected
definition: Bytes came back and were stored as a snapshot.

label: fetch error
definition: The retrieval failed before any HTTP response.

label: http error
definition: The server returned an HTTP error.

label: invalid content
definition: Bytes came back but are not the document.

label: invalid response
definition: The server returned a response that could not be read.

label: missing
definition: The document was not found at its URL.

label: not applicable
definition: No retrieval applies to the document.

label: not modified
definition: The server reported the document unchanged since the last retrieval.

label: not published
definition: The document has not been published.

label: retryable http error
definition: The server returned an HTTP error that may clear on a retry.

label: author
definition: The publisher that wrote a document.

label: beneficiary
definition: The party the activity is meant to benefit.

label: channel
definition: The party through which the money passes to the recipient, such as a development bank managing a donor's grant.

label: co signatory
definition: A publisher that co-signs a document written with others.

label: contractor
definition: The party contracted to build or supply.

label: coordinating agency
definition: The body that coordinates the parties to the subject.

label: endorser
definition: The party that endorses the subject without funding it.

label: funder
definition: The party that provides the money.

label: guarantor
definition: The party that guarantees an obligation.

label: host
definition: The party that hosts the subject, such as the body hosting a secretariat or a web page.

label: implementing entity
definition: The party that carries out the activity.

label: lead agency
definition: The public body that leads the subject.

label: operator
definition: The party that operates an asset.

label: promoter
definition: The party that puts a project forward.

label: signatory
definition: The party that signs a document.

label: standards body
definition: The body whose standard the subject follows.

label: class
definition: A term that names a kind of thing the ledger records.

label: relation
definition: A term that names a relation between two kinds, with a domain and a range.

label: value
definition: A term that names one value of a closed list.
